reviews.t: This item is not eligible for return.
reviews.x: Got2B is a great company with many great products. I thought the wax spray would be one of them. The spray worked okay, then didn't work so well after. Also, like many other customers pointed out, this item does not dry on like other wax sprays. It's sticky/tacky and the worst part, leaves a residue behind. The ugly white kind that makes your hair look like you haven't washed it in days/weeks.  Definitely will not purchase again. Oh, and because this is a flame risk, Amazon does not do Returns f

Ladies as you can see I wear a lot of wigs (( just BECAUSE I CAN LOL )) but anywho - this spray is light weight and smells very decent - I like it a lot and it’s faster - I don’t have clumps in my wigs when applying it -

reviews.t: Not what I was looking for…
reviews.x: If your looking to replace the ogx beeswax spray that has been discontinued. This is NOT it. There is little to NO wax in this product. It’s more of a dry texture spray than a moldable wax. The beeswax spray was great for frizzies, flyaways in curls or waves, also great for smoothing out braids. I do updos for proms and weddings so I used it a ton on different textures of hair. This got 2 be wax spray is nothing what it claims to be. It needs to be renamed dry texture spray and take the claim of

[[VIDEOID:751c7804e6e198e5ded49dc9fec0d6de]] I love that it's so easy with my short pixie cut. Just hit the roots lightly and scrunch and fluff. 20 sec I'm done look great and out the door. It has no scent that I've noticed. Also it cuts down on grease buildup. Hair like mine greases up so quickly since it lays limp to my scalp. I can go 3 days and still look fresh and styled. You HAVE to try it, especially at this price!!!!

reviews.t: Must have for frizz and flyaways
reviews.x: Love this stuff ! I have very course type 3c curly hair and this stuff helps my frizz and flyaways lay down. It works better than any hairspray and doesn’t build up in my hair

reviews.t: Ok spray wax for the money, but not the best
reviews.x: Doesn’t have the hold or length of use that higher quality stuff like Paul Mitchell would have. But! It’ll do in a pinch and great value for the money.

This REALLY holds well, like through hurricane force winds! There is a learning curve, don't over spray or you'll end up with a funky mess. Lightly, lightly with that button and you'll look great all day long. And, yes, you can use it to spike your hair, it WILL stay!

Smells good, I’ve not noticed any scent. Very nice price and easy to use. Not sure what I expected but the hold based on direction use is just not reflective of the hype. I guess if you spray close and use a hairdryer you might make it stickier. I do love the one and two nozzle selection. Buy it. Try it. Don’t expect anything miraculous.  Ok update; this has grown on me. I’ve used it a bit closer to my hair than recommended. It gives a nice hold that gives a lot of movement. This definitely cont

I wear a short sassy/spiky pixie and this stuff works great. I have thin hair shafts but I have a pretty good amount of hair. If a product is too heavy, it will weigh my hair down and it truly doesn't work for my hair type or style. This spray wax is a great combination of texture and hold. I buy multiple bottles at a time in fear of it not being available any more or the formula changing. I sure hope this product stays around for a long time.

This stuff comes out in a thick spray. It has an odd consistency to it. Watch out for spray residue on floors and counters! This stuff just weighed my hair down and left it sticky and clumpy. It was a mess. It takes 3-4 shampoos to get it out too. I love Got2b stuff but this stuff is horrible!! This would be better suited for someone with very short hair (1” or less) as a texturing spray. But you might as well get a gel or mousse for that.

Used mousse in the 2000's, hairspray in the 2010's, now that I found this product I don't think I will use anything else! Goes on and stay's, and when the day it done it brushes out easily with a paddle brush. Reasonably priced, doesn't take much product to give good hold so it last about three months for a can.
The texture and hold is phenomenal! It lasts all day and doesn’t flake. I still get freaked out because it sprays out white then fades to clear. I love this stuff!
I bought this to compare to another spray wax I had cuz this is much cheaper.  But this is really sticky, leaves a very tacky gummy feeling so it's not a fav.
Definitely my new go to since the other spray I used raised their price. Wishing I would of found this texture wax spray months ago. Love the brand as well
Will buy again. Provides the hold you need to maintain hairstyles.

Works as advertised. Nozzle switches between the two different products. Neither product is any better than the regular freeze spray. Regular hairspray can is vastly stronger in hold than this. This has a faint smell, slightly stronger than the regular spray version.
I decided to try this product. Believe me it WORKS! how ever you want to style your hair, this product does it for you. I'm so glad I bought this. I will be buying it again & again.

reviews.t: I use this instead of hairspray
reviews.x: On my curls they stay and don't feel stiff and my curls stay in place even if I sleep in them that night
Easy to spray on my damp hair. Makes my thin hair twice as full looking! I love it!
It sprays very well and it does great on my hair
Bottle doesn’t spray at all. Can’t return.

So I thought I was buying a hair spray and when I got it I realized It was not. However it was a very happy mistake because I love this product. It gives messy, texture, tousled, volume and hold! I love it, and would buy again!

This product has duel duty use.  There are two nozzles.  One emits a spray that lets you manage your hair to a style you like and the second one coats it with a spray like wax feature which hold well.
I thought this was my regular freeze spray but I noticed it wasn’t when I received it. But hopefully it still does the same job. I’ll keep you guys updated
I think the freeze spray is better even though I haven’t tried it yet. But I’ve compared the cans and what each product says it should do.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the strong hold and all-day staying power of the spray.
Several reviewers find the product sticky, tacky, or prone to leaving residue.
Reviewers frequently describe it as lightweight and easy to use, especially for fine or thin hair.
Some reviewers note it lacks the wax content or hold they expected compared to other wax sprays.
Multiple reviewers highlight its good value for the price.
